reasons.plausibility: Using real-time laser power modulation based on melt pool imaging is consistent with known methods to manage heat input and reduce defects in additive manufacturing, making this hypothesis scientifically sound.
reasons.testability: The proposed controlled comparison experiment (closed-loop vs. fixed-power) with clear, measurable outcomes (dimensional accuracy, porosity, mechanical tests) provides a straightforward way to test and potentially falsify the hypothesis.
reasons.usefulness: This approach directly addresses key issues (dimensional precision and defect reduction) in additive manufacturing of high-entropy alloys and provides a clear mechanism and experimental plan, making it highly valuable to researchers.
